Q: NoClassDefFoundError: org/bouncycastle/jce/provider/BouncyCastleProvider A:

According to the documentation for the java command:

When you use the -jar option, the specified JAR file is the source of all user classes, and other class path settings are ignored.

Hence you need to add the Class-Path attribute to the JAR manifest and add the [relative] path to the relevant, dependent JAR files. This means adding attributes 'Class-Path': to your Gradle file.
